info.title: Adobe Personalised Learning Buddy API
info.description: Intelligent, constraint-respecting academic learning buddy and curriculum planner for Inter IIT Tech Meet 15.0.

get.description: Lists courses with optional filtering.

schema.title: Response List Courses Api Courses Get

get.description: Retrieves full course detail including prerequisites, modules, and taught skills.

schema.title: Response Get Course Detail Api Courses  Code  Get

get.description: Returns all verified skill nodes.

schema.title: Response List Skills Api Skills Get

get.description: Returns all active academic policy rules.

schema.title: Response List Academic Rules Api Rules Get

get.description: Returns predefined goal templates for career and post-graduation pathways.

schema.title: Response List Goal Templates Api Goals Get

get.description: Returns degree structures and credit requirement rules.

schema.title: Response List Programmes Api Programmes Get

get.description: Lists available student personas for the frontend selector.

schema.title: Response List Students Api Students Get

post.description: Creates or updates a student profile.

schema.title: Response Create Or Update Student Api Students Post

get.description: Direct profile endpoint for frontend dashboard.
Returns the canonical summary for a student, using their latest saved plan when present.
Direct skill matrix endpoint for frontend radar and progress tracking.

schema.title: Response Get Student Skills Only Api Students Skills  Student Id  Get

get.description: Retrieves student profile and current BKT skill mastery estimates.

schema.title: Response Get Student Api Students  Student Id  Get

get.description:
Returns the next optimal information-gain question for the adaptive diagnostic.
Comma-separated 'answered' query param tracks questions completed in current session.

schema.title: Response Get Next Diagnostic Question Api Students  Student Id  Diagnostic Next Get

post.description: Evaluates student answer, logs evidence event, and recalibrates BKT mastery.

schema.title: Response Submit Diagnostic Answer Api Students  Student Id  Diagnostic Submit Post

get.description:
Computes quantified skill gaps, strengths, readiness percentage,
and flags interest-evidence conflicts via GapAlerts.

schema.title: Response Get Student Gaps Api Students  Student Id  Gaps Get

get.description: Returns chronological audit trail of all evidence events.

schema.title: Response Get Student Evidence Trail Api Students  Student Id  Evidence Get

post.description:
Generates a provably valid multi-semester course plan, validates it via RuleRegistry,
generates a sealed cryptographic PlanCertificate, creates a versioned snapshot,
and returns a factual explanation.

schema.title: Response Generate Student Plan Api Plans Generate Post

get.description: Retrieves the latest saved plan version and certificate for a student.
Returns the cryptographic PlanCertificate for the student's active plan.

schema.title: Response Get Plan Certificate Api Plans  Student Id  Certificate Get

post.description:
Re-evaluates all 16 academic rules from scratch against the stored plan,
checks cryptographic canonical hash match, and returns tamper detection results.

schema.title: Response Verify Plan Certificate Api Plans  Student Id  Certificate Verify Post

get.description:
Exports a clean, official one-page printable PDF certificate
with ordinance citations, verification seal, and rule audit table.
Returns chronological versions and diffs for auditability.

schema.title: Response Get Plan History Api Plans  Student Id  History Get

post.description: Demonstrates how the planner handles mathematically or regulatorily infeasible requests.

schema.title: Response Infeasible Request Api Plans Infeasible Post

get.description: Lists practice exercises with optional filters.

schema.title: Response List Exercises Api Practice Exercises Get

get.description: Retrieves exercise prompt and metadata (without leaking answer).

schema.title: Response Get Exercise Detail Api Practice Exercises  Exercise Id  Get

post.description:
Evaluates exercise submission via deterministic or sandboxed execution,
logs attempt in DB, and recalibrates student BKT skill mastery.

schema.title: Response Submit Exercise Api Practice Run Post

post.description:
Evaluates exercise submission via deterministic or sandboxed execution,
logs attempt in DB, and recalibrates student BKT skill mastery.

schema.title: Response Submit Exercise Api Practice Submit Post

post.description: Generates a newly validated question grounded in module syllabus text.

schema.title: Response Generate Practice Question Api Practice Generate Post

get.description:
Returns comprehensive mastery breakdown, explicitly distinguishing
'Completed Course' from 'Demonstrated Proficiency', with 'What's Missing' checklist.

schema.title: Response Get Student Mastery Report Api Practice Mastery  Student Id  Get

get.description: Returns the catalog of one-click scripted demo scenarios for evaluators.

schema.title: Response List Simulation Scenarios Api Adapt Scenarios Get

post.description:
Executes a scripted simulation scenario, injects synthetic activity,
evaluates policy, and returns before/after plan diffs and explanations.

schema.title: Response Simulate Scenario Api Adapt Simulate Post

post.description:
Handles a student course rejection override.
Re-solves the multi-semester plan with the exclusion constraint and details trade-offs.

schema.title: Response Submit Course Override Api Adapt Override Post

post.description:
Evaluates raw student performance/behavioral signals against active adaptation rules
and returns recommended policy actions.

schema.title: Response Evaluate Adaptation Signals Api Adapt Evaluate Post

get.description: Returns historical adaptation decisions and audit trail for a student.

schema.title: Response Get Adaptation Audit Log Api Adapt History  Student Id  Get

post.description:
Handles student multi-turn conversational interaction.
Executes safety checks, intent routing, dynamic domain tools, and grounded answer synthesis.

get.description:
Returns 'What I remember about you' persistent profile facts
and recent working context dialogue history.

schema.title: Response Get Student Memory Api Buddy Memory  Student Id  Get

post.description: Clears conversational history for the student.

schema.title: Response Clear Student Memory Api Buddy Clear Memory  Student Id  Post

post.description:
Edits a student's grade, recomputes CGPA, recalculates BKT skill mastery,
and automatically re-synthesizes the active multi-semester plan.

schema.title: Response Edit Student Grade Api Admin Grade Post

post.description:
Edits course parameters (credits, semester offering, workload), updates DB,
re-indexes in-memory planner/validator caches, and triggers plan recomputation.

schema.title: Response Edit Course Api Admin Course Post

post.description:
Adds or removes a prerequisite relationship and immediately re-syncs
in-memory DAG graphs across planner, validator, and rule registry.

schema.title: Response Edit Prerequisite Api Admin Prerequisite Post

post.description: Modifies an academic ordinance rule parameter in the DB and synchronizes rule registry.

schema.title: Response Edit Academic Rule Api Admin Rule Post

post.description: Updates student constraints and immediately re-synthesizes a compliant plan.

schema.title: Response Edit Student Constraint Api Admin Constraint Post

post.description: Restores the database to clean seed state idempotently.

schema.title: Response Admin Reset Database Api Admin Reset Post

get.description: Hidden design system styleguide route for visual verification.
